title: Ultimate-frames fall short
text: Ultimate-frames fall short. Frames are shabby chic and sizes good. But the back shows that its all connected by staples & makes it wobble when you lift it

product_metadata.title: Lawrence Frames Weathered 7-Opening Collage Frame, Antique White
features: All wood construction with glass fronts
Comes with hangers for wall mounting
Five opening collage with five metal hooks
description: This exquisite weathered antique white five frame collage ledge with 5 antique brass hooks is the perfect way to frame your special memories while beautifying your home. This one piece arrangement takes all of the guess work out of making a pleasing collage for any wall, and have the added bonus of a functional coat rack. Holds two 4x6 photos, one 3.5 x 5 photo, a 3.5 x 3.5, and a 2.5 x 3.5 photo. Hand finished and lightly antiqued for a rich designer look. Comes with hangers for sturdy wall mounting.
